newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: VASTNED OFFICES SHARES PRICED AT NLG 62.00.
newsitem.headline: VASTNED OFFICES SHARES PRICED AT NLG 62.00.

text.p: Property company VastNed Offices/Industrial NV said on Thursday its share issue to pay for the takeover of Pays-Bas would raise 232.5 million guilders.

"The size of the transaction has been fixed at 3.75 million ordinary shares...The price at which the shares VastNed O/I will be issued is 62 guilders per share, resulting in an issue size of 232.5 million guilders," VastNed said.
Should the over-allotment option be exercised, the issue size could increase to 267.38 million guilders, it added.
VastNed O/I earlier granted syndicate ABN Amro Rothschild an option to buy a maximum of 562,500 additional ordinary shares at the issue price.
It said the issue was about two times oversubscribed at the issue price, with demand coming mainly from Dutch private and institutional investors.
"About one third of the shares was allocated to Dutch retail investors, with institutional investors taking up about two thirds of the offering," the statement said.
